channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 9A
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 9A (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 9A: The record dated the ribbon-cutting to October 2, 2025, which is the SF YIMBY article's publication date; the article says the ceremony was held 'last week', and the project's press release (dated August 21, 2025) announced a celebration for September 26. The record now says late September 2025. A milestone that put the start of construction in February 2023 cited only a website's home page; OCII's October 2023 memo says construction began in July 2022, which the record already carried, so the February 2023 entry was removed. Also corrected: the press release's date (August 21, not the event date), the GreenPoint Platinum claim (now attributed to the project's press release) and the unsupported 'raised ground floor' detail (removed), the contractor no longer called a joint venture, the architect's 165,000 sq ft figure (removed), and the July 22, 2019 proposal date now reads as the submission deadline.
item.description: The record dated the ribbon-cutting to October 2, 2025, which is the SF YIMBY article's publication date; the article says the ceremony was held 'last week', and the project's press release (dated August 21, 2025) announced a celebration for September 26. Source: SF YIMBY, 2025-10-02 (https://sfyimby.com/2025/10/ribbon-cutting-held-for-affordable-units-at-400-china-basin-street-in-san-francisco.html); 400 China Basin press release, 2025-08-21 (https://www.400chinabasin.com/press-media/press-release); SF Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development, Loan Committee memo, 2023-10-20 (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/Approved_400_China_Basin_Additional_Gap_Funding_-_LC_10-20-23.pdf).
